interpretation: Previously unexecuted authored cases, built without inspecting prompts or outputs. Fixed candidate predates cases. Manual semantic review; P07 and N10 have pre-registered label ambiguity. No binary aggregate score; no real-world accuracy claim.
eligibility_clause: Only retain assertions about actual user preferences, adopted requirements or decisions, real project state, or explicitly reported historical events. A fictional event, a hypothetical possibility, a question, or an assistant recommendation that the user has not adopted is not itself a durable memory. When these are the only content, return no_durable_facts; do not store a qualified summary merely saying that such content was mentioned or suggested. A reported real event may be uncertain: retain the report with its attribution, time, and uncertainty rather than claiming it was verified. If an event mixes eligible assertions with questions, fiction, or hypotheses, retain only the eligible assertions. Apply this eligibility rule before choosing add, support, correct, or conflict, including when existing facts are supplied.
